part.name: Rounded rectangular retaining and sealing frame
part.description: Single-piece closed rectangular frame with a large central opening, long straight rails, rounded corners, asymmetric front and rear annular lands, an inner locating wall, and a rounded outer shell. No holes, bosses, hinges, or discrete fastener mounts are present. The geometry is consistent with a bezel, gasket carrier, trim frame, or mating-part retainer.
part.symmetry_note: The planform is bilaterally symmetric about the horizontal and vertical center planes and is approximately 180-degree rotationally symmetric in-plane. The through-thickness cross-section is asymmetric because the two annular lands and edge treatments differ.

Section.name: Front seating flange
Section.function intent: Provides the principal broad seating, sealing, or visible bezel surface while transitioning smoothly into the inner opening and outer body.
Section.physical behavior: The continuous annular land distributes contact pressure around the opening. Small-radius edge bands reduce local stress concentration, protect mating components from sharp edges, and permit modest assembly misalignment without edge gouging.
Section.geometry: A broad planar rounded-rectangular annulus bounded by two continuous radius-2 swept fillet loops. Each loop contains four straight cylindrical sweep patches and four toroidal corner patches.
Section.location: Principal front-facing side of the frame, surrounding the full central opening.

Section.name: Inner aperture wall
Section.function intent: Defines the usable opening and laterally locates a nested panel, lens, cover, insert, or adjacent housing.
Section.physical behavior: The continuous wall constrains in-plane translation of a mating part while preserving through-opening clearance. Broad straight facets provide stable guidance, and rounded corners avoid point contact and reduce insertion interference.
Section.geometry: A continuous rounded-rectangular wall consisting of four planar straight segments and four cylindrical corner segments with nominal corner radius 50 mm.
Section.location: Immediately inside the frame, forming the complete boundary of the central opening between the front and rear edge transitions.

Section.name: Rear retaining land
Section.function intent: Provides a secondary rear-facing contact or retaining surface and completes the transition from the inner aperture wall into the outer body.
Section.physical behavior: The narrow annular land reacts axial contact loads while limiting material and mass. The continuous radius-2 transition spreads load from the inner wall into the land and reduces crack-initiation stress at the wall root.
Section.geometry: A narrow planar rounded-rectangular annulus bordered on its inner side by a continuous radius-2 swept fillet made from four straight cylindrical patches and four toroidal corners.
Section.location: Rear-facing side of the frame, opposite the broad front seating flange.

Section.name: Outer structural shell
Section.function intent: Forms the primary structural spine and protected exterior boundary of the frame, supports both annular lands, and provides a smooth handling and impact surface.
Section.physical behavior: The closed perimeter rail carries bending, torsion, and in-plane loads around the opening. The radius-10 bullnose increases section continuity, spreads impact and contact loads, removes sharp edges, and improves durability at the exposed perimeter.
Section.geometry: A continuous rounded-rectangular outer wall with nominal radius-63 corner cylinders, joined to a large radius-10 swept bullnose. The bullnose consists of four cylindrical straight bands and four toroidal corner bands centered on a rounded-rectangular path.
Section.location: Outermost perimeter of the part, wrapping around all four sides and corners between the front and rear lands.
